earnings.title: October 29, 2026
highlights: Revenue in Q3 2026 increased 39% to $24.4 billion driven primarily by Mounjaro and Zepbound.
Q3 2026 EPS increased by 16% to $7.22 on a reported basis and increased by 7% to $7.48 on a non-GAAP basis.
Q3 2026 reported and non-GAAP EPS included $4.57 of acquired IPR&D charges compared to $0.71 in Q3 2025.

quotes.text: Lilly had another strong quarter, exceeding our prior expectations and allowing us to raise our full-year outlook.

outlook: In addition to updates to Revenue and Performance Margin guidance, EPS guidance has been adjusted to reflect an increase of $4.07 (at the midpoint of the range), offset by $4.57 associated with the Q3 acquired IPR&D charges from recent business development activity:

items.heading: Pharmaceutical research and development is very costly and highly uncertain; we may not succeed in developing, licensing, or acquiring commercially successful products sufficient in number or value to replace revenues of products that have lost or will lose intellectual property protection or are displaced by competing products or therapies.
items.group: Risks Related to Our Business and Industry

items.heading: We and our products face intense competition, and such competition could have a material adverse effect on our business.
items.group: Risks Related to Our Business and Industry

items.heading: Our business is subject to government price controls and other public and private restrictions on pricing, reimbursement, and access for our drugs, which could have a material adverse effect on our results of operations, reputation, or business.
items.group: Risks Related to Our Business and Industry

items.heading: Pharmaceutical products can develop safety or efficacy concerns, which could have a material adverse effect on our revenues, income, and reputation.
items.group: Risks Related to Our Business and Industry

items.heading: We derive a significant percentage of our total revenue from relatively few products and sell our products through consolidated supply chain entities, which subjects us to various risks.
items.group: Risks Related to Our Business and Industry

items.heading: We depend on products with intellectual property protection for most of our revenues, cash flows, and earnings; the loss of effective intellectual property protection for certain of our products has resulted, and in the future is likely to continue to result, in rapid and severe declines in revenues for those products.
